Where HomeLight shines

Big network, fast, and real cash-offer options if you need speed over price. Cash offers (Simple Sale), Buy Before You Sell, Trade-In.

Most common complaint

Reviewers frequently report a burst of calls and texts after a home-value or cash-offer request.

Is HomeLight free?

Yes for consumers — the agent pays HomeLight a referral fee (33% of the agent's commission (published)). Money Move Homes is also free; our partner agents pay 25%, disclosed up front.

What's the best HomeLight alternative?

If you want to choose your one agent from a published scorecard and keep your number private, Money Move Homes was built for that. If you need a fast cash sale, HomeLight's Simple Sale may fit better — we'll tell you honestly.

Does HomeLight sell my information?

Check their privacy policy and consent screen for "marketing partners." Common complaint: reviewers frequently report a burst of calls and texts after a home-value or cash-offer request. Money Move Homes shares your info only with the one agent you choose.
